description: This Java class defines the ModifySubjects command, which is used to modify Subjects within a PolicyEntry in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and handles serialization and deserialization, as well as encapsulating the data related to Subjects modification.

classes.name: ModifySubjects
classes.description: An immutable command class used to modify Subjects associated with a specific policy entry, including JSON (de)serialization functionalities and validation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a ModifySubjects instance from PolicyId, Label, Subjects, and DittoHeaders.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifySubjects command object from a JSON string or JSON object, deserializing the necessary fields.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label identifying the policy entry whose subjects are to be modified.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns the Subjects object containing the new subjects data.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the associated PolicyId for this command.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the subjects to be set, according to the schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path indicating where this command applies within the resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command's data payload to a JSON object builder, respecting schema version and predicate filtering.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the command category; in this case, MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ModifySubjects with updated Ditto headers.
